items.title: Henry Johnson interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: He had a group for about three years and we just played around Gary and the Chicago area.

ctx.x: You know I wanted to ask you, how did you get started playing the guitar? Who were you listening to at that time or who influenced you or what made you want to be a musician?

Well you know when I first started playing the guitar I was just 14 or 13, and a friend of mine who had a guitar laying around his house all the time, we used to just go around and © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

play around with the chords or something like that. But my grandfather was a guitar player in the church. So we played in all of the Gospel churches around the South. And I really never thought about playing the guitar, it was just something to do. When I got to be about 13-1/2, I started listening to records, to blues records and Gospel records, and I was playing with Gospel groups.
